dataset.sampling: Equal read-base prefixes from four public source BAMs, keeping complete primary records. This is file-order prefix sampling, not uniform random read sampling.
dataset.coverage_definition: Sequenced read bases divided by the full GRCh38 chr1-22 + X + Y sequence lengths, including reference Ns. Measured mapping depth is separate.

timing_method: One serial run per aligner on the same FASTQ and full reference. Wall time includes index construction and SAM writing. Standard samtools postprocessing is excluded. No repeated-run throughput qualification.

primary_comparison.interpretation: Alignment concordance and confidence differences only; neither aligner supplies mapping truth.

scope: Approximately 1x by sequenced bases on a balanced four-run prefix sample of HG002 ONT R10.4.1 ultra-long reads. Real-data runtime, structural validation, primary alignment concordance, and measured primary-only mapping coverage. No variant calling or GIAB truth-set accuracy assessment.
